name: Forearm Side Plank
description: Works the obliques: propped on one forearm with your legs stacked, lift your hips so your body makes a straight line.

source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on your left side, propped on your left forearm, elbow under your shoulder, legs stacked.
cues: Keep your head, hips and feet in line.
Easier: bend your knees and keep them down.

prescription.note: Breathe steadily; build up the hold time gradually.

keyframes.name: Prop on your forearm
keyframes.cue: Elbow under your shoulder, hips on the floor.

keyframes.name: Lift your hips
keyframes.cue: Raise your hips and hold, top arm reaching up.
